description: Indexed search, schema-checked writes and session hooks for a markdown notes vault
name: io.github.gronare/notes-vault-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the vault. Set this or the four S3_* variables.
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: S3 or MinIO endpoint URL holding the vault
environmentVariables.name: S3_ENDPOINT

environmentVariables.description: Access key for the vault bucket
environmentVariables.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Secret key for the vault bucket
environmentVariables.name: S3_SECRET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Local schema file overriding the one in the vault
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_SCHEMA

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required by the streamable HTTP transport
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Set to off to disable the stop hook
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_STOP_HOOK

title: Notes Vault
